exceptions.rationale: This stateless OAuth2 resource server accepts Authorization bearer tokens and no browser session cookie; browsers do not attach bearer tokens automatically, so CSRF is not the applicable control.

DEV/PROD internal Gateway admission is a stateless server-to-server bearer resource chain; it accepts no session-cookie, HTTP Basic or form authentication. Every admission requires a decoded and Cognito-verified access token plus a constant-time comparison with the server-configured Gateway secret. Browser session CSRF remains enforced by Gateway. CloudAdmissionSecurityTest covers cookie-only and missing credential denial in both profiles.

Reviewed false positive: the request header is a credential checked against the server-configured Gateway secret with MessageDigest.isEqual; a missing or unequal header throws OAuth2AuthenticationException and cannot return authentication. Every successful path then unconditionally calls CognitoTokenVerifier.verify before constructing authentication. CloudAdmissionSecurityTest rejects missing/wrong secrets and missing/rejected/revoked tokens in DEV and PROD; the header never selects whether token validation is performed.
